Currentroot and optional previous move to unique UUID sibling paths. Same-parent moves are individually atomic relocation operations; there is no await between these moves and wrapper entry. Replacing every checkedDirectory call with raw root would risk this control; narrow conditional repair only after actual baseline observation.
